description: A deep-dive, per-resource breakdown dashboard for the resources managed by the External Secrets Operator: ExternalSecret, ClusterExternalSecret, SecretStore, ClusterSecretStore, PushSecret and ClusterPushSecret. Shows sync call rates and errors, reconcile duration, readiness and provider API call health broken down per resource - see the Overview dashboard for fleet-wide totals. The dashboards were generated using [external-secrets-operator-mixin](https://github.com/adinhodovic/external-secrets-operator-mixin). Open issues and create feature requests in the repository.

panels.description: Rate of API calls made to the upstream provider, broken down by provider and API call type (e.g. GetSecret, PushSecret).
panels.title: Provider API Call Rate by Call [Top 20]

panels.description: Rate of failed API calls made to the upstream provider, broken down by provider and API call type.
panels.title: Provider API Call Error Rate by Call [Top 20]

panels.description: Distribution of sync call volume across ExternalSecrets over the past hour. Identifies which secrets are synced the most frequently.
panels.title: Sync Calls by External Secret [1h, Top 20]

panels.description: Distribution of sync errors across ExternalSecrets over the past hour. A concentration of errors on a single secret usually points to a specific misconfiguration, while broad errors point to a provider-wide issue.
panels.title: Sync Errors by External Secret [1h, Top 20]

targets.expr:
max(
  secretstore_status_condition{
    cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"
,
exported_namespace=~"$namespace",
name=~"$secret_store_name"
,
    condition="Ready",
    status="True"
  }
) by (exported_namespace, name)
and on (exported_namespace, name) (
  topk(40,
  max(
    secretstore_status_condition{
      cluster="$cluster",
job=~"$job"
,
exported_namespace=~"$namespace",
name=~"$secret_store_name"
,
      condition="Ready"
    }
  ) by (exported_namespace, name)
)

)
